HOME SCIENCE MARCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Careers in Food and Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Careers in Food and Nutrition.

   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li? (1 mark)

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment? (1 mark)

   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)

18. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

19. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)

   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

21. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

22. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C
